object.body:
Dear recipient,

The pinned version $processVersion of the $processName virtual appliance cluster component has expired.

The latest VA updates will be pushed to the cluster.

Thanks,
The $PRODUCT_NAME Team
object.description: Notifies when virtual appliance cluster component has been unpinned.
object.name: VA Unpinned Notification
object.subject: $PRODUCT_NAME Notification: Pinned VA cluster component $processName $processVersion has expired. The VA cluster will be updated.
